title: Vampirism Supporters
description: List of Vampirism supporters/contributors and the in-game appearance/faction assigned to them. Loaded by SupporterManager (faction, name, player, appearance, book); playerId/status/bookId are not read by the mod itself and only exist for the external supporters website.

playerId.description: Minecraft account UUID of the supporter. Not read by the mod; In case the username changes the id stays the same

player.description: Minecraft username, used to resolve the player's skin at runtime.

faction.description: Faction the supporter's in-game entity belongs to. Only vampirism:hunter and vampirism:vampire are recognized by SupporterManager's lookups.

name.description: Display name shown in-game for this supporter's entity.

status.description: Supporter category, used by the external supporters website. Not validated/consumed by the mod.

bookId.description: Legacy id. Identifier used by the external supporters website to link this supporter to their book. Not read by the mod.

book.description: Registered vampire book id (VampirismRegistries VAMPIRE_BOOK) granted to this supporter, e.g. vampirism:pyromaniacs_diary.

appearance.description: Free-form string map describing the supporter entity's appearance. Only main_hand/off_hand/head/eyes are currently read by the renderer; other keys (hat, type, body, eye, hasCloak, equipment) are legacy/website-only and unused by the mod.

hat.description: Legacy. Hunter hat overlay variant. Not currently read by the mod.

head.description: Item id equipped in the head slot, e.g. vampirism:hunter_hat_broad.

main_hand.description: Item id held in the main hand, e.g. vampirism:hunter_axe_normal.

off_hand.description: Item id held in the off hand.

equipment.description: Legacy equipment variant tag (e.g. axe, axe_stake, crossbow, double_axe). Not currently read by the mod.

type.description: Legacy. Body/skin variant index. Not currently read by the mod.

body.description: Legacy. Body texture variant index. Not currently read by the mod.

eye.description: Legacy. Eye color variant index. Not currently read by the mod.

eyes.description: Eye texture variant index, appended to 'eyes' to form the texture id (e.g. vampirism:eyes17).

hasCloak.description: Legacy. Whether the vampire's cloak is rendered. Not currently read by the mod.
